preconditions.description: The number of cities N must be between 2 and 200.
The number of roads M must be between 1 and 50000.
The prices of gold and silver coins in tugriks must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= N and 1 <= yi <= N for xi, yi, gi, si in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect cities with valid indices between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= gi <= 10**9 and 1 <= si <= 10**9 for xi, yi, gi, si in roads)
preconditions.description: The gold and silver coin requirements for each road must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal cost of the gift in Olympian tugriks.
The minimal cost must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(gi <= a and si <= b for xi, yi, gi, si in roads)
postconditions.description: The gift must satisfy the requirements for all roads.
